conditions.scope: Existing daily-tax persistence on Windows; tax formulas and authority unchanged.

change.summary: Preserve tax intent/payment/ack saves on Windows by requesting native same-volume replace-existing with write-through, then verifying the complete NBT root.

modifiers.before: Files.move ATOMIC_MOVE with REPLACE_EXISTING raises AccessDeniedException for existing world data and aborts the server tick.
modifiers.after: Windows uses Minecraft-bundled JNA Kernel32 MoveFileEx with REPLACE_EXISTING and WRITE_THROUGH, without cross-volume copy. Other platforms retain atomic move. All saves read back exact expected NBT before clearing dirty.
modifiers.notes: No suppressed I/O errors, delete-then-move fallback, taxation/balance changes or world-state edits.

rationale.purpose: Restore local server availability after the observed save crash.
rationale.decision_source: User cannot connect to local server. Codex traced actual14:01:43 crash to Windows atomic replacement, verified writable regular target and identical shutdown-written data/tmp hashes, and chose native rename using the existing Minecraft JNA dependency.

notes: Five Whys: connection refused -> server terminated -> daily-tax save threw -> Windows atomic move refused existing target -> save owner unconditionally used a Java atomic replacement that ignores REPLACE_EXISTING semantics.
Real I/O failures remain fatal/pending; no tax state discarded.
unresolved: Tax boundary execution and player acceptance remain unverified; status in testing.
